meta.title: Case Study Portfolio Viewer
meta.description: A multi-story portfolio site displaying work case studies with narrative content and a sticky contextual sidebar. Supports navigation between stories.

storySchema.description: Each story follows this data structure

fields.heading: string — display headline
fields.sections: array of section objects (see sections below)

elements.style: 4px left border in primary blue (#1428A0), paddingLeft 16px, fontSize 17px, weight 500
flex wrap, gap 8, rounded-full, border 1px solid #e5e7eb, bg white, fontSize 12, weight 500. Each pill has an inline SVG icon + label.

sections.layout: flex row — text left (flex:1), media floated right (fixed width)
sections.notes: Used for the 'The technology worked' section. Media can be a phone mockup component or image.

phoneComponent.description: A phone frame (border 8px solid #1a1a1a, borderRadius 32px) containing a dark gradient screen with a galaxy swirl gradient, a search query bubble, and a row of colored app icon squares. A pull-quote card is absolutely positioned to the right of the phone.

pullQuote.style: white card, border, borderRadius 10, shadow, width 140px

proposed.checks: CheckItem components — red X circle icon + label

vsBadge.style: 32px circle, bg #1f2937, color white, fontSize 11 weight 800, centered vertically

recommendation.checks: CheckItem components — green check circle icon + label

image.overlay: absolute inset-0 bg rgba(0,0,0,0.55) flex items-center justify-center
image.overlayText: color white, fontWeight 800, fontSize 18, textAlign center

infoBox.style: bg #e8ecf8, border 1px solid #1428A033, borderRadius 10, padding 14px 16px, flex gap 12

sections.heading: fontSize 16, fontWeight 800, lineHeight 1.4
sections.body: fontSize 13, lineHeight 1.65, color #374151, strong for inline emphasis

sections.layout: flex row, justify space-between, position relative
sections.connector: position absolute, top 50%, left 10%, right 10%, height 2px, bg #e5e7eb, zIndex 0

milestones.style: flex column, alignItems center, gap 8, zIndex 1
milestones.dot: 40px circle, bg[color], border 3px solid white, boxShadow 0 0 0 2px [color]
milestones.label: fontSize 11, color muted

sections.layout: CSS grid, 2–3 columns, gap 20–28, borderTop 1px solid #e5e7eb, paddingTop 24

columns.heading: flex row gap 6–8, icon + uppercase label 11px weight 800 letterSpacing 0.07em color muted
columns.pullQuote: color primary blue, fontSize 15–16, fontStyle italic, fontWeight 700, borderLeft 3px solid blue, paddingLeft 14

statRows.layout: flex row, gap 14, padding 14px 0, borderBottom 1px solid #e5e7eb
statRows.label: fontSize 12, color #6b7280, marginTop 2

sections.matchedTags: flex column gap 7 — green check icon (16px) + label fontSize 13

sections.additionalTags: flex column gap 7 — small icon (14px, color #9ca3af) + label fontSize 13 color #374151

components.name: TagPill
components.description: Rounded-full pill. Border 1px #e5e7eb, bg white, padding 5px 12px, fontSize 12, fontWeight 500. Optional leading SVG icon (13px). Optional green check / red X circle icon when checked prop is provided.

components.name: StatRow
components.description: Horizontal flex row. 44px circle icon container with bg opacity 13%. Bold large stat text, small muted label. Separated by bottom border.

components.name: SidebarCard
components.description: White (or tinted) card with border 1px #e5e7eb, borderRadius 12, padding 18px 20px, marginBottom 16.

components.name: SidebarHeading
components.description: Flex row with optional icon (14px) + uppercase label text (11px, weight 700, letterSpacing 0.08em, color #6b7280). MarginBottom 14.

components.name: CheckItem
components.description: Flex row. Green filled check circle (pass=true) or red X circle (pass=false) at 16px, then label fontSize 13. Used in comparison cards.

components.name: ArrowItem
components.description: Flex row gap 10. Blue arrowRight icon (14px) + text fontSize 13, lineHeight 1.5. MarginBottom 10.

components.name: PhoneMockup
components.description: 185px wide phone frame (border 8px #1a1a1a, borderRadius 32, overflow hidden). Screen has dark gradient background with a radial galaxy swirl, Galaxy AI label, a query bubble (bg rgba(255,255,255,0.12)), and a row of 4 colored app icon squares. A pull-quote card is absolutely positioned 110px to the right.

components.name: Icon
components.description: Inline SVG icon switcher. Supported names: x, arrowLeft, arrowRight, sparkles, chart, building, people, globe, star, check, close, chat, person, calendar, lightbulb, refresh, doc, ambiguity, strategy, data, influence, enterprise.

stories.heading: What happens when an AI demo proves capability—but not adoption value?
stories.subheading: 192K employees were preparing to demonstrate Galaxy AI. I thought the flagship use case was going to fail.
ifWeTalk: How I evaluate AI adoption risk before a large-scale launch
How I handle being right when a recommendation is declined
What I look for in an AI use case to make it adoption-ready
myRole: Workforce readiness strategy and use-case quality critique
Alternative recommendation anchored in context-reliable behavior
Readiness planning across multiple companies and geographies
Documented post-mortem recommendations when proposal was not adopted

stories.heading: How do you turn 20 separate logistics programs into one seller strategy?
stories.subheading: We had plenty of programs. What we didn't have was a way to talk about them as one solution.
ifWeTalk: How we validated the eight-phase lifecycle with 20 different programs
How we kept partners aligned without a dedicated team
What the next phase of adoption looks like across the organization
myRole: Wrote core copy for learning and seller materials
Led a cross-functional team to build and launch the solution

buildInstructions: Build a React single-page app with Inter font. Render a sticky top bar (close + brand/year) and sticky bottom bar (prev/next story navigation with a yellow pill button). The main area is a two-column CSS grid (1fr 320px) with a scrollable narrative article on the left and a sticky sidebar on the right. Each story's narrative contains a hero header with a blockquote hook, tag pills, then multiple content sections: narrative + media, a two-column comparison card with check/X items, an image with a dark overlay quote, a tinted callout box, a timeline, and a 2–3 column reflections grid. The sidebar has four stacked cards: stat rows, a yellow-tinted personalization card, a conversation prompts card, and a role bullets card. Wire the bottom bar arrows to an index state that swaps between story components.
